market_definition: The cellulose-based foam market comprises lightweight foams made from wood pulp, nanocellulose or regenerated cellulose used for insulation, packaging and absorbents. It measures sales of cellulose foam sheets, blocks and sponges. BY CELLULOSE SOURCE: Wood Pulp, Nanocellulose / Microfibrillated Cellulose, Regenerated Cellulose, Other Sources. BY PRODUCT FORM: Sheets, Blocks, Sponges. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Packaging, Insulation, Cleaning & Household Sponges, Medical & Hygiene, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Starch and PLA foams; cellulose insulation fibre; paper pulp moulded packaging. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CONVERTER: a distributor, stockist or foam converter / fabricator that buys this foam from its makers and sells it (as supplied, or cut, laminated or shaped) to industry. EXCLUDED companies: foam and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
